cells.gaps: No source found names three or more systems exchanging data through the national exchange; the 2025 notice requires onboarding and does not say it was done. No identifier linking records is reported.
cells.note: The regulator KMPDC's system is integrated with the health information system and the ministry launched a national exchange in August 2025 (KEN-004, KEN-001): two systems in use, 3. No source names three systems the exchange carries, and the 2025 notice requires onboarding without saying it was done (KEN-003), so not 4.
